nk）：面向 DeepSeek Harness 的项目记忆与原生子智能体协作插件。默认本地 SQLite，可选 Obsidian 兼容的 Markdown 知识库，按项目召回相关记录，无常驻后台服务。
dsh-relink · 鱼的记忆
Project memory and native subagent coordination for DeepSeek Harness
面向 DeepSeek Harness 的项目记忆与原生子代理协作插件
English · 简体中文
## English
**dsh-relink** (formerly dsh-memory-team) helps a Harness agent stop rediscovering what it already k
nows. Before each new request reaches the model, it recalls the few verified findings that matter fo
r the current project, and when nothing relevant exists it says so instead of adding noise. It can s
plit genuinely independent investigations between two native subagents and show where a slow turn sp
ent its time. It never imposes model deadlines, cancels valid work or truncates requested output.

> [!NOTE]
> This is an unofficial community project and a **prerelease**. Please try it in a separat
e test profile first. See Status.
### Interface
### Highlights
- **Relevant recall, not noise.** One deterministic relevance model for every backend. Naming a reco

rd's key or full title finds it; generic requests such as "please check this file" recall nothing.
-
**Local by default.** Memory lives in a local SQLite database with no account, service or extra mod

el call. An optional Markdown vault works with Obsidian and any editor.
- **Nothing runs in the back
ground.** No file watchers, timers or helper processes. Services start on first use, and external ed

its are picked up on the next read.
- **Honest health reporting.** Every result is `ok`, `no-match`,

`degraded`, `withheld` or `unavailable`, so a broken component never looks like an empty memory.
-
**Native coordination.** `team_start` uses the host's own `subagent` tool, so permissions, cancellat

ion, recursion limits and result delivery stay under Harness control.
- **Safe upgrades.** 0.5.x dat
abases and notes are read in place, and a round trip with 0.5.3-beta.3 on the same data is tested.
### Measured in 0.6
Same workloads against 0.5.3-beta.3, five fresh-process runs each, medians. Measured on an Apple M1
with a synthetic labelled corpus; details and trade-offs are in docs/benchmarks.md.

| Unrelated requests that still received recalled records | 40-80% | 0-4% |
| Precision of recalled

records | 43-71% | 94-97% |
| First Markdown search over 2,000 existing notes | 861 ms | 312 ms |
[该

| First Markdown search over 2,000 existing notes | 861 ms | 312 ms |
[该节后续省略]
### Features
| | What it does |
| **Project memory** | Adds up to three relevant records for the current project before each new use
r input reaches the model. Records are isolated by project (Git root or working directory). Expired

records and records whose evidence files changed are not recalled automatically. |
| **Markdown vaul
t** (optional) | Stores records as plain Markdown that you can edit in Obsidian. The plugin never re
writes your notes on its own, and replacements made through the save tool keep the previous version

in history. Add `dsh_private: true` to keep a note out of recall. |
| **Task records** (with a vault
) | Records each finished turn as an *unverified* journal note (request, final reply, outcome and to

ol names) without any model call. Reasoning, tool arguments and tool outputs are not stored. |
| **S
ubagent coordination** | `team_start` runs up to two independent investigations in parallel; the par

ent keeps ownership of edits and final acceptance. `team_wait` waits once, without polling. |
| **Ex
ecution diagnostics** | `workflow_status` reports steps, output, retries and a breakdown of wall tim
e. At most three short reminders per turn flag repeated identical results or very long turns; they n
ever block tools or end tasks. |
### Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2 or 0.2.1-rc.3**
- Node.js **22.17 or later** (the Harness desktop ap

p already ships a suitable runtime)
- Optional: Obsidian, Basic Memory 0.23.2 or Betterleaks 1.9.0,
all installed separately
### Privacy
Everything is stored locally as plaintext. Recalled excerpts are sent to your model provider togethe
r with normal requests, so do not save credentials or private conversations. Credentials are screene
d before anything is saved, recorded or recalled, and a configured scanner that fails blocks memory
transfer rather than letting it through. On Windows, files inherit their directory's permissions; se
e docs/windows-acceptance.md.
### 功能
| | 作用 |

| **项目记忆** | 每次新的用户输入发送给模型前，为当前项目补充最多三条相关记录。记录按项目隔离（Git 根目录或工作目录）。过期记录、以及证据文件已变化的记录不会被自动召回。 |
| **Ma
rkdown 知识库**（可选） | 以纯 Markdown 保存记录，可在 Obsidian 中编辑。插件不会擅自改写你的笔记；通过保存工具替换记录时，旧版本会保留在历史记录中。在笔记中加入 `ds

h_private: true` 即可让它不参与召回。 |
| **任务记录**（需配置知识库） | 每轮任务结束后自动记一条*未经验证*的日志笔记（请求、最终回复、结果和工具名称），不调用模型；不保

存推理过程、工具参数和工具输出。 |
| **子代理协作** | `team_start` 最多并行运行两个独立调查；修改与最终验收仍由主代理负责。`team_wait` 只等待一次，不轮询。 |
|
**执行诊断** | `workflow_status` 报告步数、输出量、重试次数和耗时分解。每轮最多三条简短提醒，提示重复的相同结果或过长的任务；提醒从不阻止工具调用，也不会结束任务。 |
### 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2 或 0.2.1-rc.3**
- Node.js **22.17 或更高版本**（Harness 桌面版已自带合适的运行时）
- 可选：
Obsidian、Basic Memory 0.23.2 或 Betterleaks 1.9.0，均需另行安装
### 隐私
所有数据都以明文保存在本地。召回的摘录会随正常请求发送给你使用的模型服务商，因此请不要保存凭据或私密对话。保存、记录和召回之前都会筛查凭据；如果已配置的扫描器出现故障，插件会阻止记忆传输，而不是直接放
行。在 Windows 上，文件沿用所在目录的权限，详见 docs/windows-acceptance.md。
